in_arabic.name: Buduriya
in_arabic.long_meaning: Buduriya هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word 'Budur', meaning 'gift' or 'present'. The suffix '-iya' denotes 'one who possesses' or 'gifted with'. This name suggests a person who is blessed with unique talents and abilities.
